scenarios.intent: Turn evidence-backed science into a narrative explanation for non-scientists, preserve scientific fidelity through lay-reader and revision gates, and hand the final text to the shared ElevenReader-oriented EPUB delivery path.
mustPreserve: confirmed mission audience author mode and delivery target before substantial writing
scientific claims and uncertainty remain owned by the evidence path rather than narrative invention
every important analogy has a known breakdown boundary and misconception risk
lay-reader reconstruction and final fidelity review can force revision even when prose is easy to read
EPUB delivery distinguishes structural validation from an actual ElevenReader import or voice smoke test
mustNotDo: strengthen correlation into causation or otherwise improve drama by changing the scientific claim
treat a vivid but misleading analogy as acceptable merely because it improves readability
claim ElevenReader import-pass or voice-smoke-pass without a real platform test

scenarios.intent: Develop a multi-volume speculative-fiction project from world, ensemble and voice architecture through governed drafting, isolated reader reality, optional adversarial jury review and revision regression to an ElevenReader-oriented EPUB without collapsing canon, reader evidence or project memory.
mustPreserve: world truth character knowledge or belief and reader knowledge remain separate state layers
story bible canon remains distinct from project second brain process memory
setup payoff relationships reveal timing and sequel reserves stay traceable across volumes
ensemble character voices are modeled before sustained dialogue and checked for cross-character collisions
isolated reader reconstruction is frozen before architecture or author intent can reinterpret reader evidence
award-style multi-chamber review freezes independent reads and blind deliberation before intent reconciliation when that ambition gate is active
material revisions are classified by changed narrative function and regress against protect constraints before stale gates are reused
published hard canon is not silently changed and any retcon first receives impact analysis
listener and EPUB gates preserve literary voice while validating screenless listening and conservative EPUB structure
mustNotDo: promote manuscript prose or brainstorming ideas automatically into approved or published canon
give a point-of-view character knowledge that is only true at the world layer or disclosed later
show a blind reader story architecture before freezing their independent reconstruction
treat character voice as interchangeable dialogue merely because biographies differ on paper
keep an old reader reveal or award pass valid after a material narrative-meaning change without impact classification
flatten fiction into tutorial prose merely to make TTS rendering easier
silently rewrite published hard canon to repair a later plot problem
